name: com.kudimistudios/catalogue
title: Kudimi Studios catalogue
description: Kids' songs, Shorts, books and free printables (ages 0-12): search, recommend by age, licence terms.

tools.name: get_piece
tools.description: One Kudimi piece in full: description, age band, topics, characters, pages, page and picture links, vendor offers and licence.

id.description: Piece id from search or recommend, e.g. book:count-with-chiku

tools.name: licensing_terms
tools.description: What is free (playing videos, printing printables for home, class and library) and what needs permission, and how to buy.

tools.name: list_characters
tools.description: Kudimi characters (Kudimi the giant panda, Chiku the tiger cub, Tara the firefly and friends) with their pages.

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: The best Kudimi pieces for a child's age and an optional topic (counting, bedtime, letters, tracing, mazes, colouring, first words, songs, calm, riddles). Mixes a video, a free printable and a book where they exist.

age.description: The child's age in years (0 to 12).

topic.description: What the child is into or learning.

type.description: Optional kind: book, printable, video, short, song, guide, podcast.

tools.name: search_catalogue
tools.description: Search Kudimi songs, Activity Shorts, activity books, free printables, parent guides and the bedtime podcast by words, kind, age and price.

type.description: Optional kind: book, printable, video, short, song, guide, podcast.

age.description: The child's age in years (0 to 12).

free.description: true for free pieces only, false for paid only.

tools.name: submit_partner_enquiry
tools.description: Send Kudimi Studios a partnership, licensing, wholesale, school or library, press or integration enquiry from an adult or a business. Only on the user's request and with their details. A person replies by email. No payments.

confirm_adult.description: The sender confirms they are an adult acting for themselves or a business.
